content:
The Weaver

Her fingers fly, her shuttle sings,
Thread over thread, the pattern springs.
Red as the dawn, and black as night,
She weaves the cloth in morning light.
Each knot a story, each line a song,
The cloth will last when she is gone.
What hands have made, no time can break,
For love is woven, not just made.

questions.explanation: Each knot is a story; the cloth outlasts the weaver.
